import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react'; import { Container, Typography, Grid, Card, CardContent, Box, Chip, Alert, CircularProgress, Table, TableBody, TableCell, TableContainer, TableHead, TableRow, } from '@mui/material'; import { People as PeopleIcon, School as SchoolIcon, Business as BusinessIcon, Assignment as AssignmentIcon, CheckCircle as CheckCircleIcon, Pending as PendingIcon, TrendingUp as TrendingUpIcon, } from '@mui/icons-material'; import { useAuth } from '../context/AuthContext'; import { adminAPI } from '../services/api'; const AdminDashboard = () => { const { currentUser } = useAuth(); const [stats, setStats] = useState(null); const [recentActivities, setRecentActivities] = useState([]); const [pendingCompanies, setPendingCompanies] = useState([]); const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true); const [error, setError] = useState(''); useEffect(() => { fetchDashboardData(); }, []); const fetchDashboardData = async () => { try { setLoading(true); const response = await adminAPI.getDashboardStats(); setStats(response.data.stats); setRecentActivities(response.data.recentActivities || []); setPendingCompanies(response.data.pendingCompanies || []); } catch (err) { setError('Failed to load dashboard data'); } finally { setLoading(false); } }; const StatCard = ({ title, value, subtitle, icon, color = 'primary' }) => ( {title} {value} {subtitle && ( {subtitle} )} {icon} ); if (loading) { return ( Loading Admin Dashboard... ); } return ( {/* Welcome Section */} Admin Dashboard System Overview & Management {error && ( setError('')}> {error} )} {/* Statistics Grid */} } color="primary" /> } color="secondary" /> } color="success" /> } color="warning" /> {/* System Overview */} System Overview Welcome, System Administrator Email: {currentUser?.email} Role: {currentUser?.role} {/* Quick Stats */} Platform Statistics Active Faculties Available Courses Job Postings Pending Approvals {/* Pending Companies */} {pendingCompanies.length > 0 && ( Pending Company Approvals Company Name Industry Contact Email {pendingCompanies.slice(0, 3).map((company) => ( {company.name} {company.industry} {company.email} ))}
)} {/* Recent Activities */} Recent System Activities {recentActivities.length > 0 ? ( User Role Action {recentActivities.map((activity) => ( {activity.email} {activity.action} ))}
) : ( No recent activities )} {/* Admin Portal Info */} Administrative Controls Use the navigation bar above to access all administrative features: • Manage all user accounts and permissions • Approve company and institution registrations • Monitor system-wide courses and faculties • Generate comprehensive system reports ); }; export default AdminDashboard;
